rules.rule: Claude accesses NovaX system through bridge server on :9999 using /shell, /write, /read endpoints
When Python server problems occur, always fall back to PowerShell as next solution
Claude can reach Windows filesystem through localhost:9999/read, /write, /shell, /api/files/read
Nova AI brain on :9997 has /api/chat endpoint for AI queries but NO shell access
Bridge :9999 is the ONLY path to execute commands, read/write files on the Windows machine
If Python fails or has syntax errors, generate PowerShell equivalent immediately
PowerShell commands must be given ONE AT A TIME - user pastes everything as one line otherwise
